historical_growth.growth_rate_source: mid-cycle judgment: 15th Five-Year Plan volume build-out (+70Mt by ~2031, ~6%/yr) net of a ~2-3%/yr real coal-price drift under decarbonization; neither the FY2022-peak-anchored 3-yr CAGRs nor the FY2020-trough-anchored 5-yr CAGRs is a usable forward rate for a commodity cyclical
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5-yr CAGR 4.3% vs revenue 5-yr CAGR 14.0% (>30% divergence): revenue grew by acquisition (Luxi, Xinjiang Nenghua 2023; Xibei 2025, common-control restatement lifting FY2024 revenue 124.5bn -> 141.1bn) while equity was held down by payouts above FCF funded with debt and perpetuals. 3-yr CAGRs are all negative because FY2022 was the cycle peak.
historical_growth.notes: EPS CAGRs are on a bonus-issue-adjusted basis (as-printed EPS rescaled to the 10,040m current count: FY2020 1.29 -> 0.62, FY2022 6.13 -> 3.02 vs FY2025 0.85); the stored EPS column is as-printed and not comparable across 2023/2024. Owner-FCF CAGRs are undefined: the series ends negative (FY2025 owner FCF RMB-967m = 600 - 84 SBC - 1,482 interest income) against FY2020 RMB3,886m and FY2022 RMB56,598m. Reported FCF fell 99% from the FY2022 peak while SBC stayed immaterial, so the gap between reported and owner FCF is the interest-income strip, not SBC. Consolidated unlevered FCF (OCF + interest paid - interest received - cash capex) averaged RMB9.8bn/yr over FY2023-25 (7.5% of revenue), which the base-case mature margin of ~11% sits above; the difference is the assumed halving of the working-capital drain.

scenario_narratives.base: Coal and coal-chemical prices settle at a mid-cycle below the FY2018-25 median: domestic supply-demand 'relatively balanced with periodic tightness' as management frames 2026, with the Middle-East-driven oil/gas premium supporting coal-to-chemicals spreads. Volume grows ~6%/yr from the seven-mine build-out (+70Mt by ~2031) while realised prices drift down 2-3%/yr under renewables substitution, netting to ~3% revenue growth that fades to 1%. Cash conversion improves only halfway: the working-capital drain (related-party prepayments, mining-rights payables) halves from the FY2023-25 pace rather than disappearing. Capex stays above D&A to FY2030 and settles at 12%. The parent's power-asset dropdown and Yancoal's Kestrel purchase are paid at roughly fair value. Exit at 12x FCF, the cap binding over Gordon at 8%/1%.
scenario_narratives.bull: The H1 FY2026 recovery (+57% attributable profit) holds: tighter domestic supply after capacity verification, sustained seaborne thermal and met-coal prices (Kestrel adds premium coking coal), and high-end chemicals reaching >70% of the chemicals mix lift gross cash EBITDA back to the historical median (33%). Related-party receivables are collected, mining-rights payables run off, and leakage falls to 1.5pp. The new mines ramp on schedule so revenue compounds ~4-5% through FY2030, capex fades to maintenance plus 1pp, and coal-power integration damps the cycle enough for a 14x exit. This requires several independent things to go right (price, delivery, governance), which is why it carries the smallest weight.
scenario_narratives.bear: China's coal share of generation keeps falling as renewables approach half the mix; after FY2026, thermal prices retreat to a permanent FY2020/FY2025-type trough and the chemicals segment loses its oil-linked cushion. Revenue drops ~10% in FY2027 and then erodes ~1%/yr as new capacity only offsets price. Gross cash EBITDA sits at 26.5% and the FY2023-25 working-capital drain (6.5% of revenue, mostly to related parties) persists, leaving ~22% net. Capex is cut to D&A as in FY2020/FY2022, but RMB86bn of net debt, RMB32bn of perpetuals and RMB73bn of NCI rank ahead of the ordinary shares, so the equity absorbs the whole shortfall: this scenario values the H-share at or below zero, i.e. the ordinary equity does not survive a permanent trough on the current capital structure. Dividends were paid through FY2023-25 by adding RMB67bn of net debt and RMB18bn of perpetuals; in this case that stops.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A mid-cycle owner-FCF valuation of a leveraged, SOE-controlled coal cyclical, built on cash EBITDA (not the PBT-derived figure, which carries associates' profits and recurring 'one-off' gains) with a recurring working-capital leakage allowance, consolidated flows with NCI and perpetual capital securities deducted once at carrying value, and a 10x-14x FCF exit cap that binds in every scenario. The headline finding is that reported earnings and the dividend overstate what reaches the ordinary shareholder: FY2023-25 consolidated unlevered FCF averaged RMB9.8bn/yr while ordinary dividends alone averaged RMB14.2bn/yr, the gap funded by RMB67bn of added net debt and RMB18bn of perpetuals. The H-share's 49% discount to the A-share is consistent with that reading. House and street bases coincide (SBC 0.06% of revenue).
key_risks_to_valuation: NCI valuation: deducted at book RMB72.9bn, the top of a RMB58-73bn range; every RMB10bn is ~HK$1.17/share
Working-capital leakage assumption (3pp base): each 1pp of revenue is ~RMB1.5bn/yr of FCF, roughly HK$1.5-2.0/share of value at 8%
Mid-cycle gross cash EBITDA margin (30% base vs 34.7% FY2018-25 median): each 1pp is ~RMB1.5bn/yr of EBITDA
Related-party dropdowns (RMB16.4bn power assets, Kestrel) assumed value-neutral; overpayment would be a direct deduction
Terminal cap multiple (12x) rather than Gordon sets the exit; a 10x cap removes ~HK$1.5/share from the base
A/H price gap: the valuation is of the H-share at the HKD quote; the A-share at CNY 19.04 implies the market attaches very different values to the same economic share

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API for 1171.HK at inputs.price_as_of (HKD, intraday); CNYHKD=X and 600188.SS from the same endpoint for the fx_note parity check; 52-week range 9.53-17.42.
data_sources.financials: research/1171.HK/Reports/1171.HK_Metrics.csv and the kpis table (FY2018-FY2025 annual, H1 FY2023-FY2026 interim) via make dcf-context; FY2025 annual report consolidated cash flow statement (1171.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt:10835-10960) for the cash-EBITDA and working-capital reconciliation; 2026 interim report condensed balance sheet and cash flow (1171.HK_HalfYear_H1-2026.txt:6225-6505) for the 30 June 2026 anchors; cash-EBITDA history from each annual report's 'Operating cash flows before movements in working capital' line.
data_sources.qualitative: research/1171.HK/Reports/1171.HK_Analysis.json (2026-10-16): segment mix, FY2026 guidance (186-190Mt coal, RMB19.8bn capex, 50% payout), 15th Five-Year Plan capacity targets, pending acquisitions, bull/bear axes.

inputs.share_count_basis: 10,036,852,000 ordinary shares (A + H, one class economically) per the 30 June 2026 interim balance sheet share capital, after cancellation of 628,524 repurchased restricted shares. Held FLAT: SBC (0.06% of revenue) is expensed in the flows; the only dilutive instrument is the 2021 A-share restricted share scheme (tens of millions of shares, immaterial against 10.04bn) and a non-wholly-owned listed subsidiary's scheme that dilutes EPS only. Per-share HISTORY is not comparable: bonus issues lifted the count 4,949m -> 7,439m (2023) -> 10,040m (2024).
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report consolidated cash flow statement, 'Share-based payment expenses' RMB84,459k (1171.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt:10876); no equity-award tax line exists (EquityAwardTaxes = 0 every year). Effectively an SBC-zero filer.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 financing activities show no repurchase; H1 FY2026 repurchased RMB51.7m of restricted shares for cancellation. The RMB0.5-1.0bn A-share buyback mandate had not been executed as of 31 May 2026 (authorized is not spent).
inputs.fx_note: CNY->HKD 1.1728 from Yahoo CNYHKD=X at 2026-10-16T05:07Z. All flows and per-share values are computed in CNY and multiplied by 1.1728 to the HKD H-share quote. Dual-listing parity does NOT hold and cannot validate the rate: the A-share 600188.SS at CNY 19.04 is HK$22.33 at this rate against the H-share quote at inputs.price_as_of, i.e. the H-share trades at a ~49% discount to the A-share (A/H premium ~96%). Direction is validated by magnitude instead: the H-share quote divided by 1.1728 is ~CNY 9.7 per share, an H-share-implied market cap of ~CNY 98bn against CNY 191bn at the A-share price; both are plausible against FY2025 attributable net profit of CNY 8.5bn. The H-share is the quote being valued; the A/H discount is a market fact, not a valuation input.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-16T03:59:50Z (intraday HKEX print, 11:59 HKT, before the lunch break; 52-week range 9.53-17.42)
inputs.cash_note: Cash = 'Bank balances and cash' RMB42,385m at 30 June 2026 only. EXCLUDED: restricted cash RMB12,359m (statutory work-safety deposits and pledged balances, not distributable) and pledged term deposits RMB151m. RMB5,335m of short-term bank deposits held at amortised cost are added separately in the equity bridge. The 30 June 2026 balance includes the one-off RMB18,361m performance-compensation receipt from parent Shandong Energy (profit-guarantee shortfall on injected assets), received in H1 FY2026 and shown in financing activities; it is real cash and is counted once, here.
inputs.debt_note: total_debt = borrowings only: RMB77,211m non-current + RMB51,236m current at 30 June 2026 (interim note 18). Lease liabilities (RMB225m) are excluded under lease treatment (B). Average financing cost 2.46% in FY2025. Perpetual capital securities (RMB31,811m, equity-classified, distributions ~RMB0.64bn/yr not in the P&L) are deducted in the equity bridge, not here.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the currency of the flows: risk-free 1.8% (10-yr China Government Bond, Oct-2026), equity beta 1.15 x China ERP 7.0% = 8.05%, plus a 1.5pp SOE/related-party governance premium (controlling shareholder is the largest supplier, a top-5 customer and the counterparty on every asset injection) = cost of equity ~11.3%. After-tax cost of debt 2.46% x (1-0.23) = 1.9%. Market-value weights ~65% equity (incl. NCI and perpetuals) / 35% debt -> 7.4%, rounded to 8.0%. The SAME 8.0% is used in all three scenarios: cyclicality is priced in the scenario flows and weights, governance once in the discount rate (adaptations section f, risk charged once). Not a USD- or HKD-derived rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) leases as operating cost: lease principal (RMB641m) + lease interest (RMB43m) in FY2025 = 0.51% of revenue, charged inside adjusted EBITDA via lease_cost_pct_path = 0.5%; lease liabilities (RMB225m at 30 June 2026) EXCLUDED from net debt. D&A for cash tax uses D&A ex right-of-use depreciation (FY2025 RMB15,804m total less RMB419m ROU = 11.5% of revenue) so the lease is not charged twice.
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are CONSOLIDATED (they include the minorities' share); non-controlling interests are deducted ONCE, in the equity bridge, at carrying value RMB72,872m (30 June 2026). NCI is ~40% of total book equity but took 21-39% of profit after tax in FY2023-25 (mid-cycle ~28%) because the NCI-heavy subsidiaries (Xibei Mining 49% NCI acquired 2025, Xinjiang Nenghua, Luxi Mining, Yancoal Australia 37.7% NCI) are in a build phase. Cross-check: NCI at 28% of consolidated EV is ~RMB58bn, Yancoal Australia's listed minority alone is ~RMB15bn at market and Xibei's 49% is ~RMB13.5bn at the 2025 deal price, so book (RMB73bn) sits at the upper end of a RMB58-73bn range. Each RMB10bn of NCI value is CNY ~1.0 / HK$1.17 per share.
inputs.ebitda_basis: ebitda_margin_path is CASH EBITDA: the cash flow statement's 'Operating cash flows before movements in working capital' (profit before tax + finance costs - interest income + D&A - share of associates/JVs - non-cash gains/losses), LESS a recurring working-capital leakage allowance. It is NOT the PBT-derived EBITDA in the metrics (FY2025 RMB39.2bn), which carries RMB2.5bn of associates' profit (only RMB0.8bn received as dividends), a RMB1.7bn one-off waiver of mining-rights payables, a RMB1.1bn intangible disposal gain and RMB0.7bn of unrealised FX. Gross cash EBITDA margin history: FY2018 35.7%, FY2019 32.1%, FY2020 28.0%, FY2021 35.7%, FY2022 44.8% (peak), FY2023 40.9%, FY2024 restated 33.7%, FY2025 24.7% (trough); median 34.7%. Mid-cycle GROSS set at 30% (base): the median less ~3pp for the low-margin logistics segment (11% of revenue, +361% in FY2025) and ~1.5pp for decarbonization price pressure. Working capital has drained cash in six of the last seven years (FY2019-25 average 4.0% of revenue, FY2023-25 6.5%, H1 FY2026 ~6.3%): prepayments and other receivables are RMB52.4bn (39% of revenue, largely related-party), long-term receivables RMB9.6bn, and RMB15.3bn of mining-rights long-term payables are being paid down. A 3pp recurring leakage is folded into the base margin (bear 4.5pp, bull 1.5pp), giving NET mid-cycle margins of 27% / 22% / 31.5%. Reference: FY2025 'Cash generated from operations' was 18.0% of revenue, FY2024r 28.0%, FY2023 33.6%, H1 FY2026 ~23%. Interest income is excluded from the margin (and from last_fcf) because the gross cash it is earned on is credited in net debt.
inputs.capex_basis: Cash capex = purchase of PPE + intangibles (mining rights) + ROU assets + deposits paid for PPE/intangibles: FY2025 RMB17.7bn (13.3% of revenue), FY2024r RMB20.1bn (14.3%), H1 FY2026 RMB10.8bn (vs 7.9bn in H1 FY2025). Company-definition capex was RMB22.05bn in FY2025 with FY2026 guided at RMB19.8bn. The 15th Five-Year Plan targets +70Mt of salable capacity (seven mines, 2027-2031) on 186-190Mt FY2026 guidance, so capex stays above D&A (11.5%) through FY2030 and settles at 12% (base) against 1% terminal growth.
inputs.acquisitions_note: Two large pending related-party/strategic cash deals are treated as VALUE-NEUTRAL and kept out of both the flows and the bridge: the ~RMB16.4bn purchase of Shandong Energy's New Energy Group and Shanneng Power Sales (13.25GW, ~22.9bn kWh/yr; announced June 2026, after the 30 June balance sheet date in cash terms) and Yancoal Australia's USD1.85bn upfront + up to USD550m contingent purchase of Kestrel Coal Group (80% of the Kestrel coking coal JV). Their revenue is excluded from the growth paths and their cash cost from net debt. Overpayment on parent dropdowns is the governance axis of the bear case and sits in the WACC premium and the bear weight.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component route, with the non-US/cyclical adaptations (owner-fcf-adaptations.md sections a-f): CNY flows against an HKD quote, CNY-built WACC, lease treatment (B), NCI and perpetual capital securities deducted once in the bridge, excluded income matched by its source assets in the bridge, SBC near zero, risk charged once. Routing: integrated coal mining and coal-chemicals operating company, cyclical, non-US -- not a bank/REIT/holdco. Mid-cycle normalization is done in the EBITDA margin path (cash-EBITDA basis, see ebitda_basis), not by flexing FY0: FY2025 reported FCF of RMB600m is a trough-year figure after RMB16.0bn of capex and a RMB9.0bn working-capital drain, and owner FCF (last_fcf) is negative once interest income is stripped. Horizon 10 years (FY2026-FY2035): year-1 margin is still recovering from the trough and capex is above maintenance until FY2030. STREET/HOUSE BAND: SBC is 0.06% of revenue (RMB84m on RMB133bn), an SBC-zero filer; the explicit SBC rows are kept at 0% so house and street coincide and the band collapses (band_position null, not a view). FY0 SBC is still recorded in inputs.sbc for the owner-FCF anchor. Terminal cap multiples 10x/12x/14x FCF (cyclical range) bind in every scenario at an 8% WACC; the cap, not Gordon, sets the exit.

bear.margin_note: 22% net = 26.5% gross (between the FY2020 and FY2025 trough years, made permanent) less 4.5pp leakage (the FY2023-25 average drain persists). Capex flexes down to ~D&A as it did in FY2020/FY2022 but the committed FY2026 programme is spent.

base.growth_note: FY2026 +8%: H1 FY2026 revenue +15.4% YoY on price recovery and 186-190Mt coal guidance, H2 comparing against a firmer H2 FY2025. FY2027 +2% as prices normalise, then +3.5% through FY2030 as the seven new mines ramp, fading to 1%.
base.margin_note: FY2026 24.5% net (H1 ran ~29.5% gross / ~23% net); 27% net mid-cycle thereafter = 30% gross cash EBITDA less 3pp working-capital leakage. See inputs.ebitda_basis.
base.tax_note: Effective rate 22.9% FY2025, 23.3% FY2024, 25.9% FY2023 (statutory 25%, western-region subsidiaries at 15%); applied to unlevered EBIT.
base.wc_note: -5% of the revenue change: receivables + inventory exceed payables growth modestly; the structural drain is in the margin, not here.

bull.margin_note: 31.5% net = 33% gross (the FY2018-25 median less logistics dilution only) less 1.5pp leakage as related-party receivables are collected and mining-rights payables run off.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 12x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 25%: the equity is a thin residual behind RMB190bn of debt, perpetuals and NCI claims, cash conversion has deteriorated for three years, and the primary regulator (decarbonization policy) and the controlling shareholder (related-party dropdowns, 17% of procurement, 10% of sales) are single-point dependencies; not higher because the bear already assumes a PERMANENT trough margin and an SOE with 2.5% funding cost does not face refinancing risk. Bull cut to 20% because it needs price, mine delivery and fair dropdown pricing to all go right. Base 55%.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
